title: We find the gap, build the platform, and launch it.
intro: We build five types of platform: e-commerce stores, travel and booking sites, content and publishing sites, price comparison sites and free online tools. Starting from open-source foundations keeps our costs down, and every project is set up for the rules of the market it launches in.

steps.title: Explore opportunities
steps.description: We look for markets with steady demand and a clear gap: products, prices or information that people struggle to find in one place.

steps.title: Build on open source
steps.description: We build on proven open-source frameworks and our own reusable templates, so a new platform needs less custom work and costs less to run.

steps.title: Launch locally
steps.description: Each platform launches for a specific market, set up for its language, currency, privacy rules and consumer law from day one.

steps.title: Privacy & data protection
steps.description: Each platform follows the privacy and data-protection law of its market, with clear policies and only the data it needs.

steps.title: Advertising & consumer law
steps.description: Commercial links and sponsored content are labelled, and prices and claims meet local consumer and advertising rules.

steps.title: Local company & tax
steps.description: Where a market requires it, we operate through the right local business structure and meet its tax obligations.

verticals.title: E-commerce
verticals.description: Online stores, each set up with the right supplier, storefront and local trading rules for the region it sells into.

verticals.title: Travel & booking
verticals.description: Destination guides plus flight and hotel search, with bookings handled by trusted partners.

verticals.title: Content & publishing
verticals.description: Editorial sites that answer real questions clearly enough for readers to come back.

verticals.title: Price comparison & deals
verticals.description: Comparison and deal platforms that pull offers from many retailers into one place, so shoppers see the best price at a glance.

verticals.title: Free online tools
verticals.description: Useful tools that visitors can use for free, such as calculators, converters and checkers, with no sign-up needed.
